description: This file is a shell script designed to verify the installation and version of a command-line interface (CLI) tool. It checks whether the CLI is available in the system's PATH or in npm global directories, extracts its version, and compares it against an expected version. It also performs a basic help command execution to ensure the CLI runs correctly.

methods.name: verify_installed_cli
methods.description: A function that verifies if a CLI tool is installed at the expected version by checking its presence in PATH or npm directories, and confirming it runs correctly.
